clarification: detectability is judged on the CLEAN FORWARD label (label B: from the next 1m open after the decision minute to the window end / event horizon, threshold = the category threshold scaled by sqrt(remaining_minutes / window_minutes)); the category event label (label A) contains the first 5 decision minutes and is reported only. Event-conditioned categories (EARLY_EXIT, MULTI_SESSION, NQ_SECONDARY_BREAKOUT, PULLBACK_RESUMPTION) are scored at their own trigger minute over all triggers of that type. LOSS_ALT / OTHER are diagnostic (no detectability). W1 covers bars ending 09:31..10:30.
